programme.title: South Park: Le Fantastique Mystère de Pâques
programme.desc: Stan se demande pourquoi on doit peindre des œufs le jour de Pâques. Il ne s'attendait pas à découvrir un secret aussi énorme.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with The White Beard Pirates!
programme.desc: Still searching for a route to the island in the sky, the Straw Hats chart a course for Jaya. Meanwhile, Fire-Fist Ace crashes a party aboard a vessel helmed by Buggy the Pirate!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, The Town Of Ridicule!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats drop anchor at a town overrun by scallywags, so Nami makes the boys swear to stay out of trouble. But when the Bellamy Pirates come looking for a fight, Luffy may have to break his promise!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks Of Dreams And The King Of Undersea Search!
programme.desc: Nico’s handy work unearths a solitary dreamer who may know the way to Sky Island. All Luffy and his crew have to do is survive the sonic onslaught of simian salvagers seeking to sink the Going Merry!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and his mates reach the home of Mont Blanc Cricket: the man with the key to reaching Sky Island. There’s just one tiny problem – he comes from a long line of legendary liars.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South bird!!
programme.desc: Montblanc Cricket agrees to help the Straw Hats reach Sky Island, but first they must venture deep into the darkest depths of a spider-infested forest to capture a mysterious bird with a keen sense of direction.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy Versus the Saruyama Alliance!
programme.desc: While the Straw Hats battle creepy-crawly forest creatures on their quest to capture a South Bird, Mont Blanc and his monkey minions are brutally attacked by the Bellamy Pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!
programme.desc: Luffy turned the other cheek during his first encounter with Bellamy, but now he’s out to settle the score for old man Mont Blanc. Meanwhile, a fearsome pirate crew takes aim at the Straw Hats, eager to earn a bad reputation!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Take to the Sky! Ride the Knockup Stream!
programme.desc: Thanks to some modifications to the Going Merry, the Straw Hats are on their way to that island in the sky! But with the Blackbeard Pirates in hot pursuit, navigating the vertical currents will be anything but easy.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Sail the white sea! The sky knight and the gate in the clouds!
programme.desc: Reaching the sea of clouds proves easier than surviving in it when giant sea creatures attack the Going Merry, Usopp nearly drowns in a cloud, and a strange sky knight issues the Straw Hats a warning!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Godland, skypiea! Angels on a beach of clouds!
programme.desc: After hitching a ride on a speedy shrimp, the Straw Hats reach the land of Skypiea! The intrepid pirates have much to learn about their new surroundings, but a beautiful angel makes a perfect tour guide.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The forbidden sacred ground! The island where god lives and heaven's judgement!
programme.desc: Nami’s eagerness to explore the forbidden realm of Upper Yard brings her face to face with the wrath of god, and the Straw Hats incur Heaven’s Judgment for failing to pay their immigration fees!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Already criminals?! Skypiea's upholder of the law!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats are no strangers to living on the wrong side of the law, but unpaid immigration fees and Nami’s assault of a White Beret earns Luffy’s crew a sentence of death by cloud drifting!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Is escape possible?! God's challenge is set in motion!
programme.desc: Nami, Zoro, Chopper, and Robin are trapped aboard the Going Merry when it’s commandeered by a monstrous lobster! To rescue his crew, Luffy must venture onto the sacred grounds of Upper Yard!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A trap on lovely street! The almighty eneru!
programme.desc: Conis helps Luffy and his mates launch their rescue mission, but the rubber-man senses something amiss. When he presses her for answers, a vengeful god takes a shot at the Straw Hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Onward, crow! To the sacrifical altar!
programme.desc: Zoro dukes it out with a hungry Skyshark in the shadow of the Sacrificial Alter. On the other side of Upper Yard, Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp try to survive their visit to an island that wants them dead!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: 10% survival rate! Satori, the mantra master!
programme.desc: Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp tangle with Satori and his exploding, snake-filled Surprise Clouds. The sky priest may look like a dancing dango, but the impact of his mantra leaves the pirates bloodied and boatless.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The ordeal of spheres! Desperate struggle in the lost forest!
programme.desc: Usopp and Sanji try to regain control of the Crow, and Luffy stirs up a brutal barrage of bursting balls when he attacks Satori. Meanwhile, Chopper whistles for the Sky Knight to avoid becoming a sacrificial reindeer!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Chopper in danger! Former god vs. Priest shura!
programme.desc: Chopper fights bravely to stop Shura from incinerating the Going Merry, but the little reindeer is no match for a sky priest. Gan Fall is on his way, but will the dispossessed deity arrive in time?

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Profound mystery! Ordeal of string and ordeal of love?!
programme.desc: When Gan Fall is badly burned during his battle with Shura, Chopper musters the courage for a death-defying leap of faith. Elsewhere, Luffy may have finally discovered a way to defeat Satori!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Light the fire of shandora! Wyper, the warrior!
programme.desc: The Shandorians prepare for an all-out attack on their priestly adversaries, Chopper meets the mysterious creatures that saved his life, and Nami makes an astonishing discovery about the origins of Upper Yard.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Jaya, city of gold in the sky! Head for god's shrine!
programme.desc: While the Shandorians continue their battle for control of Upper Yard, the Straw Hats celebrate their happy reunion by swapping stories over a campfire and feasting on barbequed Skyshark!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Festival on the night before gold-hunting! Feelings for vearth!
programme.desc: Laki’s pursuit of precious Vearth causes one of her Shandorian comrades to be injured during the battle with Ohm. As night falls on Upper Yard, the Straw Hats dream of gold while dancing with wolves!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enter god eneru!! Farewell to the survivors!
programme.desc: The electrifying deity of Skypiea, God Eneru, grants his priests unlimited power in their hunt for the Straw Hats. Usopp has a plan to get the mysteriously-repaired Going Merry back in the water, but it involves using Chopper as bait!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A giant snake bares its fangs! The survival game begins!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats scatter when their search for gold uncovers a giant python, and Gan Fall reveals the tragic story of Jaya’s arrival in the sky. Meanwhile, Wyper readies the Shandorians for a raid on Eneru’s shrine!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The deadly reject! War demon wyper's resolve!
programme.desc: As the heartless god of Upper Yard eagerly anticipates the dawning of Sky Warefare, the Shandorian forces are savagely snared by the Ordeal of String, and Luffy wanders into the fight of his life!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Fierce midair battle! Pirate zoro vs. Warrior braham!
programme.desc: Zoro rushes to perfect a deadly technique known as the Flying Blade Attack. The move proves difficult to master, but it could be the key to the swordsman surviving a battle with the Shandorian warrior, Braham.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The roaring burn bazooka! Luffy vs. War demon wyper!
programme.desc: Sanji and Usopp are driven to their knees by the electrifying presence of god, Luffy is nearly incinerated by Wyper’s Burn Bazooka, and Nami joins Gan Fall in a fight against two killer clones!

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on the 2007 murder of Jennifer Turner, married but separated from Dr. Kirk Turner, due to his infidelities with the family banker, Tondja Colvin. Jennifer had filed for divorce and also brought an alienation of affection suit against Tondja.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on the separate disappearances in 2003 of three young women, and the investigations which not only eventually discovered the one individual who had known all three women, but led to his conviction as the killer of the three.

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: The story of David Camm, who was convicted in two murder trials -- each eventually overturned -- and was found not guilty in his third trial for the murder of his wife and two children.

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: A report on the deaths of four women: Tracy Ann Roberts, Kim Raffo, Barbara Briedor, and Molly Jean Dilts, all suspected prostitutes and/or drug addicts. They were all found on November 20, 2006, in a ditch near the Golden Key Motel in Atlantic City, NJ.

programme.title: 48 Hours

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Alex tries to polish the diamond-in-the-rough, Louie, into a real gem—while Louie decides to change his image by moving into a fancy apartment building.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.sub-title: Alex Gets Burned By An Old Flame

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: To what lengths will boyfriend Arnie go to win over Elaine's kids? Elaine is in for a surprise when she invites him over to meet her children.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies come to the rescue when Jim tries to convince his family that he didn't squander his inheritance by buying a run-down restaurant.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Latka worries that Simka's wacky behavior might cost her the right to remain permanently in America.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: The cabbies embark on a frantic race against time when they team up in a wild nonstop drive from New York to Miami so that Alex can see his long-lost daughter on her twenty-minute layover at the airport in the premiere episode of Taxi.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lors d'un grand nettoyage dans la maison de campagne, April et les tortues découvrent un vaisseau Krang caché dans la cave. La mère d'April y était conservée en hibernation.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey a encore tout saccagé dans le salon en rejouant une scène de Crognard le Barbare. Ses frères lui passent un savon et le forcent à nettoyer, ce qui le pousse à s'enfuir dans la forêt.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En revenant de l'épicerie locale, Casey et April trouvent les tortues faisant la sieste. Casey s'indigne tandis qu'April s'inquiète car elle n'arrive pas à les réveiller.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Donnie croisent un dangereux chauffard sur la route. Ils apprennent aux informations qu'il est activement recherché et décident de le prendre en chasse.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Donatello teste un nouvel appareil sur April, censé mesurer ses pouvoirs psychiques. Mais par un phénomène étrange, elle se met à voir à travers les yeux d'un volatile mutant géant, mélange de lombric, d'oiseau, et de poisson.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leonardo se fait attaquer par un daim dans la forêt, suite à quoi, il décide d'organiser une retraite pour lui et ses frères afin de se reconnecter avec Mère Nature.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues apprennent par un flash info que tout va bien à New York, mais que la ville a été mise en quarantaine. Ce message est tout sauf rassurant, et elles décident de retourner dans la grosse pomme.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues retournent dans leur ancien repaire. Elles en ramènent des souvenirs et autres objets précieux. Leonardo a récupéré le vieux portrait de famille de Maître Splinter. Quand celui-ci revoit Karaï bébé, son émotion est vive et perceptible.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues poursuivent leur mission qui est de retrouver Karaï. Elles ne disposent que d'un seul indice et se séparent pour chercher dans plusieurs lieux sélectionnés par Donnie.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, première partie
programme.desc: Mikey joue dans le laboratoire de Donnie et fabrique accidentellement du rétro-mutagène. Splinter ordonne aux quatre frères de rendre leur apparence humaine aux New-Yorkais krang-formés par les Krangs.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.sub-title: La Bataille de New York, deuxième partie
programme.desc: Les tortues embarquent dans leur ballon dirigeable et partent à l'assaut de la Dimension X.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey Jones garde une dent contre les tortues, pour ne pas avoir été du voyage dans la Dimension X. Il aura à cœur de démontrer que la ville de New York peut compter sur lui comme justicier.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder envoie Rocksteady et Bebop récupérer des produits chimiques pour mettre au point un sérum de manipulation mentale pour Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Shredder et Stockman la mouche tiennent enfin la substance indispensable pour mettre au point leur formule de contrôle de la pensée.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Casey et Mikey font du skate et rencontrent un nouveau mutant, Jason, qui est devenu un gecko.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Stockman mouche a rendu sa forme humaine à Karaï. Il lui enfonce un parasite dans l'oreille, qui conditionne son cerveau à obéir aux ordres de Shredder sans discuter.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Leo et ses frères font une étrange rencontre, venue du futur. La jeune et belle Reinette est poursuivie par un horrible démon mutant du nom de Savanti Romero. Celui-ci veut lui subtiliser le Sceptre du Temps.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les quatre frères poursuivent leur voyage dans le temps et se retrouvent au Japon, dans un passé pas si lointain. Aucune trace de Reinette. Par contre, ils sont cernés par des ninjas du clan Hamato.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Après plusieurs tentatives ratées et une entorse au pied, les tortues réussissent à s'introduire dans le labo de Stockman la mouche et dérober un parasite du cerveau. Le but : permettre à Donnie d'inverser le processus et de sauver Karaï.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Mikey fait l'idiot dans le labo de Donnie, qui travaille sur un nouveau sérum anti-parasite destiné à Karaï. À force de jouer, il fait tomber des flacons d'une étagère au contenu dangereux et renverse le sérum sur Donnie, mais pas seulement.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: À l'aide des Mascottes de Baxter Stockman, Karaï parvient à attirer les tortues une à une. Elle veut ainsi pousser Splinter à l'affronter en duel. Mais son plan machiavélique ne s'arrête pas là...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: La légende urbaine de l'homme-dinosaure, sur laquelle enquêtait Kurtzman, rattrape Doc Rockwell et Slash dans les égouts de New York. Ces derniers sont mis K.O. par une créature étrange, et Raphaël est appelé à la rescousse pour la neutraliser.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues rencontrent le mystérieux Bishop, qui signe ses messages d'une pièce d'échecs (le fou, pour Bishop). Il leur apprend que la Terre est doublement menacée par les Krangs qui ont enfin réparé leur Technodrome.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues et tous leurs alliés (Slash et les mutanimaux, Mondo Gecko, Muckman) tentent d'empêcher les Tricératons d'activer le générateur de trou noir et d'aspirer la Terre. En vain. Le capitaine Mozar kidnappe Mikey et l'emmène dans l'espace.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues ont embarqué pour un voyage sidéral sur le vaisseau du Fugitoïde. Elles partent à la recherche du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons après un bond Tachyonique qui leur a permis de changer d'époque.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues percutent le vaisseau des Salamandres et atterrissent en catastrophe sur une planète recouverte de glace de méthane. Elles doivent de toute urgence récupérer de l'irrilium pour réparer leur vaisseau.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: En visitant la carcasse d'un vaisseau spatial, Casey découvre une boîte mystérieuse et la ramène à bord. Le fugitoïde explique qu'il s'agit d'un hypercube renfermant des créatures de la cinquième dimension.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Lord Dregg envoie Armaggon, un requin chasseur de primes, traquer les tortues. Celles-ci se réfugient dans une station spatiale abandonnée, dirigée par Omni-Intel, un ordinateur de bord qui entend se débarrasser de tous les êtres vivants.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde stationne le vaisseau près d'une planète où les Tricératons pensent tenir le premier fragment du générateur de trou noir. Il a bien l'intention de les prendre de vitesse, mais tout ne se passe pas comme prévu...

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey
programme.desc: Le fugitoïde rencontre un informateur nommé Vrax Belebome qui détiendrait les plans du vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Ce dernier prend l'argent de fugitoïde, mais il refuse de donner les précieuses informations en échange.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues arrivent à s'introduire dans le vaisseau amiral des Tricératons. Mais elles sont faites prisonnières et deviennent des gladiateurs dans l'arène Tricératon.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1993, the state of Florida was known for more than just Disney World. Worldwide attention focused on a rash of robberies which targeted tourists. Some vacationers were killed in these attacks, but some fought and survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: For six years, a serial killer prowled the streets of New York City. He wrote letters to police and The New York Post, indicating he would kill twelve people — one for each astrological sign.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 1987, a human skull and some bones were discovered at a Boy Scout Camp near Farmington, Missouri. Facial reconstruction aids the investigators in this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Two sets of scientists probe a woman's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An examination of the 2002 DC area shooting spree that resulted in ten murders.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: For 15 months, a serial killer was strangling prostitutes in Florida, then taunting police by leaving the bodies in plain sight. The only clues were a tire impression and some threads.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An investigation of a pediatrician, prompted by the mysterious death of one of her patients, leads to a Texas hospital where the pediatric mortality rate is higher than at any hospital in the country.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman convicted of killing her mother in a car fire is granted a new trial. An expert witness has a different opinion as to how the fire started and, if proven, would clear the woman of any culpability.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: On Halloween night 2004, Adriane Insogna and Leslie Mazzara were brutally murdered in their Napa, California home.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When a car was found in a drainage ditch with two bodies inside, a fingertip torn from a latex glove would point investigators to both the crime scene and the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nancy Newman and her two daughters are found brutally murdered. The crime scene has no shortage of evidence, but investigators cannot find a conclusive link to their prime suspect. To solve the puzzle, an FBI analyst designs a unique experiment.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace; his remains were found a year later in a remote campsite.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A young woman suddenly becomes critically ill, eventually leaving her unable to walk. A bone marrow test reveals the cause: arsenic poisoning. Investigators must determine if the poisoning was caused by groundwater contamination or something sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: By using techniques she saw on forensic science TV shows, a mother determines who was responsible for the accident that permanently injured her 4-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: California police had several suspects in the robbery and brutal murder of an elderly couple. Ten years later, a determined forensic scientist used material from a dentist's office to uncover ballistic evidence that had been overlooked.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony travels back to his homeland, his roots, his favorite state in the union: New Jersey. Part nostalgia, part cautionary tale. Tony makes sure to hit up some NJ classics.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Is My Nigerian Boyfriend Scamming Me?
programme.desc: Josie, 64, says she has met the love of her life, Victor, on Facebook. He’s Nigerian, 30 years younger, she has never physically met him, yet insists it's true love. Dr. Phil took cameras to Nigeria to find Victor, to see if he’s telling Josie the truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is the number one reason why couples say they get divorced. The country's current financial crisis has resulted in more couples getting buried in a landslide of debt which takes its toll on a marriage. Is your marriage on the rocks because of debt?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alisha says her son, Kevin, 10, pushed the family to the limit with violent outbursts. At home, knives and lighters are hidden & siblings lock themselves in their rooms at night. Alisha's says the 'future Kevin' may hurt the entire family or end a life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a gripping two-part series, Dr. Phil sits down with a family torn apart over accusations of the unthinkable. Melody says her 4-year-old granddaughter revealed that she was touched inappropriately by a man in a mask, and that the man was her daddy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Pageant Mom: Did She Put Her Daughter In Danger?
programme.desc: Pageant mom Lori & daugther Alaska, 9, made news bleaching the girl's teeth & dyeing her eyelashes. Alaska's pic posted on TheDirty.com, with a man's claim he performed a sexual act while looking at the photo. Plus, Brittany, 21, had sex with a 14-yr-old.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Boyfriend Is Married & His Wife Is Irrelvant To Me
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 18, says she is tired of her mom butting into her love life with boyfriend Eric. Mom Courtney says it's because Brooklyn's boyfriend has two children & a wife! Eric's wife, Mandy, wants Brooklyn to leave her husband alone & she'll fight for him.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked about guests on Dr. Phil returns--Brandon! Plus, a desperate family turns to Dr. Phil to save their daughter who is addicted to OxyContin and heroin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Held Captive, Drugged, And Abused By My Own Father
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to Tatiana about a horrific tale of survival: From ages 6-25, her dad forced her to do drugs to sexually abuse her daily; he impregnated her 4 times & she had 3 of his children; he tortured her & beat her with a bat; he stabbed her twice.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising My Granddaughter Because I Think My Daughter Is Violent, Abusive & Neglectful
programme.desc: Susie says she's at the end of her rope raising her 4-yr-old granddaughter & says daughter Adriana, 20, neglects her duties to spend time boyfriend Matt. Adriana strongly denies. Matt says he's judged for past drug use. Don't miss this emotional Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: With Nancy Grace, children's rights attorney Paul Mones & criminologist Dr. Denise Boots, Dr. Phil delves into the headlines: a starved & beaten teen escaping his torturers, an 8-year-old boy arrested for killing his father & two reporters found dead.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Help! My Narcissist Ex Is Abusing My Children And Nobody Believes Me
programme.desc: Pamela says she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations. Pamela says Justin attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Justin says they are lies!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Fiance Believes He's A Superhero
programme.desc: Kalan says Giovanni made a major shift in his identity two days after he asked her to marry him. The army veteran changed his persona to superhero, wears a mask, and only answers to “Goose Wayne Batman.” Kalan won't walk down the aisle with a masked man.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Help! I'm Going To Inherit A Messy Mansion, Millions And My Adult Sister
programme.desc: Lydia says she's living in her dream home with a view reminding her of Italy and of being in love. Daughter Kim calls it an overcrowded and messy mansion and is afraid she'll inherit the mess, plus her sister who lives in the basement! Dr. Phil mediates!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Facebook, unexpected things happen, like reuniting with a loved one or being fired after posting an inappropriate photograph. It can also be a lifesaver, offering a human connection when all seems lost. Dr. Phil delves into a story that made headlines.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Accusations Of Compulsive Lies, False Charges, & Coaching: A Dad's Fears About His Daughter's Safety At Mom's House Pt. 1
programme.desc: Daniel says he and Lynsey are in a custody battle filled with lies and accusations and daughter Sophie, 4, is caught in the middle. Lynsey says after a visit with Daniel their daughter came home saying he hurt her. Dr. Phil sifts through the chaos. Part 1

programme.title: The Air I Breathe
programme.desc: A drama based on an ancient Chinese proverb that breaks life down into four emotional cornerstones: happiness, pleasure, sorrow and love. A businessman bets his life on a horse race; a gangster sees the future; a pop star falls prey to a crime boss.

programme.title: Boot Camp

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Die Wüsten-Krieger
programme.desc: Ein älterer, wettergegerbter Raph kämpft gegen Straßengangs in einem post-apokalyptischen Mutanten-Ödland.

programme.desc: Während sie durch das Wüsten-Ödland streifen, sucht das Team nach einem mysteriösen Einsiedler, der ihnen dabei helfen soll, die mythische Oase zu finden.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Karmageddon
programme.desc: Bevor sie auf dem Weg zur Oase ihrem bislang größten Feind gegenübertreten, muss Raph erst gegen die Anführer der Straßen-Krieger-Clans kämpfen, um ihre Loyalität zu erringen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Splinter erlaubt seinen Söhnen, den Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, zum ersten Mal die Stadt über ihnen zu erkunden, bei ihrem Besuch entdecken sie das die Stadt komplexer ist als sie auf dem ersten Blick erscheint.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Splinter erlaubt seinen Söhnen, den Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, zum ersten Mal die Stadt über ihnen zu erkunden, bei ihrem Besuch entdecken sie das die Stadt komplexer ist als sie auf dem ersten Blick erscheint.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raphael rastet aus als ein New Yorker namens Vic ihn beschimpft. Als Vic die Turtles mit seinem Handy filmt, müssen die vier jungen Helden ihn aufspüren, um zu verhindern, dass ihr Schatten-Dasein publik gemacht wird.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Michelangelo freundet sich über eine Social-Network-Seite mit seinem Karate-Idol Chris Bradford an. Damit will er beweisen, dass auch die Turtles mit Menschen befreundet sein können. Doch was er nicht weiß: Bradford ist Teil von Shredders Team...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.sub-title: Ich glaub, der Typ heißt Baxter Stockman
programme.desc: Die Turtles schleichen sich heimlich aus der Abwasserwelt hinauf in die Stadt, um mit April ins Kino zu gehen. Dort treffen sie auf Baxter Stockman, ein verrückter Erfinder, der sich einen mechanischen Panzeranzug gebaut hat.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello hat es satt mit einem einfachen Holzstab gegen die technologisch fortgeschrittenen Kraang zu kämpfen. Deshalb baut er 'Metalhead', einen ferngesteuerten Turtle-Roboter, mit dem er sich gegen die Technologie gewappnet fühlt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatello und April untersuchen den Fall eines vermissten Wissenschaftlers. Doch bei ihren Nachforschungen stoßen sie auf ein äußerst mysteriöses Experiment: Es geht um einen übersinnlichen Affen...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Da Leo eine Erpresserbande laufen gelassen hat, befüchtet er nun, dass sich das beim Kampf gegen Xever rächen wird - dieser hat nämlich einen Restaurant-Besitzer gekidnapped.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Nachdem April eine Warnung von ihrem Vater erhalten hat, der immer noch von den Kraang gefangen gehalten wird, begibt sie sich mit den Turtles auf Rettungsmission - Sie müssen Aprils Vater befreien und die Stadt vor einer riesigen Mutagen-Bombe bewahren.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Die Turtles müssen ihr Versteck in der Kanalisation verteidigen, das Bradford durch eine gefährliche Chemikalie zerstören will.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Da es gleich mehrere Bedrohungen gibt, müssen sich die Turtles in zwei Gruppen aufteilen. Donnie und Mikey wollen dabei unter Beweis stellen, dass sie als "B-Team" genauso erfolgreich sind wie Leo und Raphs "A-Team".

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Michelangelo hat einen neuen Freund gefunden, der mutierte Alligator Leatherhead, der ungewöhnliche Kraang-Technologie besitzt. Die anderen wissen nicht so recht, ob sie dem Neuen trauen können.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.sub-title: Ein neues Mädchen ist in der Stadt
programme.desc: Weil er Raphs ständige Kritik satt hat, überlässt Leo seinem Bruder die Rolle als Anführer. Kurz darauf lernt er ein wunderschönes, aber auch gefährliches Ninja-Mädchen kennen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Die Turtles müssen sich einem neuen Gegner stellen: Dem Rattenkönig. Und der will nicht nur die Stadt in seine Gewalt bringen, sondern auch Splinter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Als Aprils Schulprojekt die Aufmerksamkeit der Kraang auf sich zieht, müssen die Turtles ihnen eine Lehrstunde verpassen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Eine Menge Ärger bahnt sich an, als die Turtles auf einen Teenager treffen, der als Möchtergernheld namens "der Pulverizer" das Verbrechen bekämpfen möchte.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Als sie in das Bürohochhaus der Firma TCRI eindringen, das Hauptquartier des Feindes, erfahren die Turtles die wahren Absichten der Kraang und beschließen, die Invasion der Aliens ein für alle Mal zu beenden.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Während die Turtles versuchen, einen Invasionsplan der Kraang zu vereiteln, werden sie von einer riesigen, unzerstörbaren Kakerlake verfolgt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Weil er es leid ist, von Fischface und Dogpound erniedrigt und von den Turtles besiegt zu werden, sinnt Baxter Stockman auf Rache, indem er seine Hassobjekte in ein tödliches Labyrinth lockt...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Karai verbündet sich mit den Turtles im Kampf gegen eine neue Waffe der Kraang. Doch dieses Bündnis steht unter einem schlechten Stern..

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Shredder beauftragt Karai damit, April zu entführen. Und da die Turtles verhindern müssen, dass die Kraang das Wasser in New York vergiften, können sie April nicht helfen...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Als Shredder den Plan ausheckt, eine furchterregende Mutantenarmee aufzustellen, lassen sich die Turtles notgedrungen von Pulverizer helfen, der als neuester Rekrut des Foot Clans Informationen liefern kann...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Als Leonardo, Raphael und Donatello unter die Kontrolle einer parasitären Wespe geraten, muss Michelangelo alles geben, um seine Brüder zu retten.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Donatellos Versuch, Aprils Vater Kirby aus der Gefangenschaft der Kraang zu befreien, droht zu scheitern, weil Kirby zusammen mit einem tödlichen Mutanten eingesperrt wurde...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Die Turtles müssen einen letzten, verzweifelten Versuch unternehmen, das Alienportal im TCRI-Gebäude zu vernichten, um so die Welt zu retten...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Während die Turtles auch weiterhin alles geben, um die Menschheit zu retten, stellt sich Splinter seiner Vergangenheit und erfährt, wer Karai wirklich ist...

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutantenproblem
programme.desc: Als Shredder sich mit Kraang zusammen tut, um an eine Dosis Mutagen zu kommen, werden die Probleme der Turtles immer schlimmer- sogar Ihre Freundschaft mit April steht auf dem Spiel.
